terminal_reason: Fixed on main: .github/workflows/pytest-run.yml sets cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' }} (L98), so a push to main no longer cancels the previous main run; the comment at L90 records why. Checked 2026-09-30.
what: main has no completed post-merge pytest-run: .github/workflows/pytest-run.yml sets concurrency group pytest-run-${{github.event_name}}-${{github.ref}} with cancel-in-progress: true, so on push to main every merge cancels the previous main run. The suite takes ~18.5 min (1113s on 2026-09-29) and merges land every few minutes, so main's pytest-run is CANCELLED run after run (SA-PROV observed a9f9bb26 cancelled, 222a4bed in progress, 2026-09-29 ~13:56Z). Consequence: a semantic break between two PRs each green against an older base (e.g. #14179 + #14172) is never caught by CI on main. Fix: for push events on main use cancel-in-progress: false (queue) or group by github.sha; keep cancel-in-progress for pull_request.
